ideas.pitch: A lightweight edge-device anomaly classifier trained using Adaption platform for micro-grid power monitoring.
ideas.title: AdaptionModel Studio: Custom Edge Classifier for Smart Local Grids
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly aligns with the hackathon theme of 'Own Your AI: Train a Model That Solves a Real Problem' while emphasizing custom model generation via Adaption's platform.

ideas.pitch: An agriculture diagnostic tool using a custom-trained image classification model to detect early-stage crop nutrient deficiencies.
ideas.title: CropShield AI: Custom Plant Disease & Stress Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages real-world problem-solving with custom model training, a core focus of the hackathon's scoring rubric regarding practical utility.

ideas.pitch: A localized inventory demand forecasting model trained on synthetic micro-retail datasets using Adaption's training tools.
ideas.title: SupplyPulse: Custom Demand Forecasting Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates rigorous mathematical modeling and data preparation within the strict 48-hour window, similar to top-performing forecasting hacks.

ideas.pitch: A custom text classification model that categorizes and prioritizes citizen-submitted municipal complaints by urgency.
ideas.title: CivicLog: Automated Municipal Issue Triage Model
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses an obvious civic pain point with a clear end-to-end ML pipeline, emphasizing data curation and model training over generic wrappers.

ideas.pitch: A localized computer vision model trained to identify road hazards (potholes, unlit paths) from dashcam imagery.
ideas.title: SafeRoute AI: Custom Urban Hazard Detection Pipeline
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines computer vision with a demonstrable custom model workflow, making it stand out among teams relying on pre-built generic LLM API wrappers.
